name: Subagent Router
description: Give Cindy's subagents a model chain: pick models per group, drag to order them, and the next model takes over when one fails.
whenToUse: When subagents should run on cheaper models, when a failing model should hand over to the next one, or when providers and models need grouping by task difficulty.

router_status.description: Report whether the Pi extension is injected, where its files live, and the saved model groups.

router_install.description: Write the bundled Pi extension and register it in Cindy's Pi extension settings (idempotent).

router_uninstall.description: Remove the extension entry and its files, leaving no residue (idempotent).

router_config_get.description: Return the saved model groups and their model order.
